item.title: Vipers In Diapers? A Response To "My Kids Are Pagans" [Let's Talk Eschatology]
item.description:
Pastor Tim Bushong and Alex Kocman, Communications director of ABWE International, discuss recent online discussions on the role and position children play in the Church and within Christian families.

Are they, like pastor Voddie Bauchum has said, "vipers in diapers", or do they hold a set apart or special status?
item.author: Tim Bushong
item.itunes:author: Tim Bushong
item.itunes:summary: Vipers In Diapers? A Baptist View of Children

item.title: EP1 Brian Sauve: Building Christian Families [Let's Talk Eschatology]
item.description:
Pastor and musician Brian Sauve, co-host of Haunted Cosmos and the King's Hall Podcast, as well as Bright Hearth, and Dr Josh Howard talk about the basics of thinking generationally and building christian families.

From topics like biblical masculinity, to the relationship between families and nations, and a look at 1 Corinthians 7 and 'holy' children, you will find this a great starting place for deepening practical theology for the household.
item.author: Dr Josh Howard
item.itunes:author: Dr Josh Howard
item.itunes:summary: 5 Keys To Biblical Masculinity and Practical Household Theology
